Through hypnosis sessions with her big brother Joseph (Simon Yam), the trauma that the family sustained is unexpectedly reawakened when she desires to connect back with the memories.  Then, the whole world around this family takes on a dark form and love becomes almost undefinable.

title: New Religion (2022)

title: Come Back Home (2022)
